experiment: HLS-S3b memory × change dynamics × observation opportunities (contract-instrumented reproduction)

design.organizational_problem: B2 full one-to-one matching; same six feasible matchings in every cell
design.change_schedule: deterministic recurrent alternation; transitions at interval multiples
design.observation_rule: pre-generated exogenous per-pair/per-period mask; policy sees feedback only after assigning that pair
design.reward_model: Bernoulli(c_ik(t)); all selected outcomes contribute to realized reward whether observed or not

random_streams.opportunity_masks: random.Random(seed XOR 0x0B5E7A), period-agent-task; thresholds nested at .25/.75

design.calibration: first 9 periods use existing fixed E1 matching cycle and count in reward

algorithms.UCB1: existing PairwiseBanditEstimator; empirical mean + sqrt(2 log(max(2,t+1))/n)
algorithms.SW-UCB: same estimator, global-time window W=1214, xi=2.0; published SW-UCB confidence form
algorithms.adaptation_note: single-play bandit analyses are not claimed for simultaneous pairwise matching

design.oracle: exact maximum true-mean complete matching; evaluation only and independent of observation masks
design.main_outcome: expected cumulative collective matching reward and expected regret against the dynamic oracle
design.main_contrast: paired-seed SW-UCB minus UCB1 regret within each factorial cell; frequency×availability difference-in-differences
design.hypothesis: the effect of memory choice on collective regret depends jointly on competence stability interval and exogenous per-pair feedback opportunity probability
design.hypothesis_criterion: report paired main effects and interaction with 95% t intervals; no directional winner is presupposed
design.resource_costs: no independent resource-cost variable exists in this B2 S3b model; assignment count is structural, not a cost
design.rho_opportunity: p_observe × stability interval; descriptive opportunity count, not a universal performance law
design.rho_effective: observations actually received per relevant pair per stability interval, conditional on organization selecting the pair

infrequent/high.constraints: exact full 3x3 one-to-one matching; same six feasible matchings in every condition
infrequent/high.information_regime: B2 semi-bandit; per-pair feedback opportunity p=0.75 is hidden until after matching; only executed pairs with available feedback are observed
infrequent/high.aggregation_rules: sum expected reward over 10,000 complete-matching periods

infrequent/low.constraints: exact full 3x3 one-to-one matching; same six feasible matchings in every condition
infrequent/low.information_regime: B2 semi-bandit; per-pair feedback opportunity p=0.25 is hidden until after matching; only executed pairs with available feedback are observed
infrequent/low.aggregation_rules: sum expected reward over 10,000 complete-matching periods

frequent/high.constraints: exact full 3x3 one-to-one matching; same six feasible matchings in every condition
frequent/high.information_regime: B2 semi-bandit; per-pair feedback opportunity p=0.75 is hidden until after matching; only executed pairs with available feedback are observed
frequent/high.aggregation_rules: sum expected reward over 10,000 complete-matching periods

frequent/low.constraints: exact full 3x3 one-to-one matching; same six feasible matchings in every condition
frequent/low.information_regime: B2 semi-bandit; per-pair feedback opportunity p=0.25 is hidden until after matching; only executed pairs with available feedback are observed
frequent/low.aggregation_rules: sum expected reward over 10,000 complete-matching periods

summary.inference_unit: paired seed; periods are not independent replicates

configuration.policy_formula: empirical pair mean + sqrt(2 log(max(2,t+1))/n)
configuration.matching_solver: exact maximum-weight matching over six permutations
configuration.resource_model: no separate resource cost; one complete matching executes three pairs per period

random_seeds.purpose: potential task-pair outcomes, indexed by period-agent-task
exogenous per-pair feedback masks; nested availability levels

information_available.policy_view: past observed outcomes on executed pairs only
information_available.competence_matrices: hidden from policy; evaluation-only in period trace
information_available.observation_opportunity_mask: unavailable before matching; feedback mask revealed after execution

observation_model.reward: Bernoulli competence for each selected pair
observation_model.feedback: selected pair outcome observed iff its exogenous mask is available

units.interpretation: Expected collective matching reward per period.
Sum of realized selected-pair outcomes.
Difference from exact true-mean matching oracle.
Three pairs are executed per period; not a resource cost.
Squared probability-scale estimation error.

metrics.name: original_reward_cumulative
metrics.interpretation: Sum of expected rewards of executed complete matchings.

metrics.name: realized_reward_cumulative
metrics.interpretation: Sum of realized rewards for selected pairs, whether feedback was observed or not.

metrics.name: expected_regret_cumulative
metrics.interpretation: Sum of exact true-mean matching oracle reward minus selected matching expected reward.

metrics.name: optimal_matching_rate
metrics.interpretation: Fraction of periods matching the exact true-mean oracle matching.

metrics.name: assignment_count_cumulative
metrics.interpretation: Three executed pairs per complete matching; structural count, not a modeled cost.

metrics.name: mean_estimation_mse
metrics.interpretation: Unweighted mean of per-pair temporal squared estimation errors.
